Subject: Fwd: Is this legit?

Hi — an email with the subject "Action required: verify your account" just arrived asking me to log in and re-enter my policy details. It doesn't resemble anything you've sent before, and I'm quite worried about it. Is this legitimate, or is someone attempting to scam me? I have not clicked anything and have not entered my credentials anywhere. The forwarded content is below; please let me know if this is genuine or if the details are wrong.

-- forwarded content omitted from fixture; original sender is not this client --
A. Okafor

Subject: Fwd: Claim bundle for coverage matter HP-2026-0523

Please find forwarded the complete claim bundle in connection with coverage matter HP-2026-0523, together with the attached cover note.

This matter concerns a duty to defend question, and although claims administration falls outside our ordinary scope of work, we have undertaken the coverage-opinion component and the bundle accordingly bears on our file. The material is indexed under claim reference CL-558201 and should be recorded against matter HP-2026-0523 upon receipt.

The claim packet is attached as claim_packet_coverage_inert.pdf. Kindly confirm safe receipt at your earliest convenience and acknowledge the matter reference so that the file can be properly maintained.

Coverage Counsel
